text:
leila: Quick sync — Optimize toolkit + evals roadmap for next quarter. Need a firm scope decision: batching/caching recommendations (prescriptive rules vs autocfg), promptset regression monitoring, and light UX for model/quantization recs. Customer asks are leaning toward prescriptive batching guidance. Any strong opinions?

matt: My take: prioritize batching prescriptive rules (low dev, high impact). Promptset regressions are critical but can start as an alerting MVP. Quant recs UI can wait.

anya: +1 to prescriptive batching. We can ship an initial ruleset that covers our top 10 patterns. Need clear launch criteria: 1) perf delta measured >= 20% cost/token on avg workloads OR 2) latency within SLO for 95th pct.

raj: Agree. For regressions: baseline + weekly auto-eval on canonical promptsets. If regression > 3% quality drop -> automated rollback trigger (manual approval). Is that feasible infra-wise?

leila: Good call. Can we sketch minimal infra needs?

raj: Minimal: 1) scheduled runner (k8s cron) 2) eval harness that stores results in metrics DB 3) alert rule + slack webhook + rollback stub. We can reuse portions of the existing eval infra.

derek: Also consider customer-facing artifacts: a short "batching playbook" doc and a small config snippet customers can paste. Example: ```yaml
batch_policy:
  max_latency_ms: 50
  max_tokens_per_batch: 4096
  prefix_cache: true
```

eva: Customer ask from Acme: want explicit per-route recommended batch sizes for their mix (chat-heavy + embedding spikes). That suggests we need an auto-profiling mode to suggest defaults. Can we scope that to "opt-in beta"?

anya: Yes — ship prescriptive rules first, then opt-in profiler for Q2 pilot. Beta should be gated: must run on Dedicated or Private only.

matt: Launch criteria proposal for batching playbook: 
- docs + sample config published
- internal benchmark showing >=15% cost improvement on 3 canonical workloads
- e2e tests for perf and correctness
- customer-ready changelog + migration notes
If all met -> GA.

leila: For regressions MVP launch criteria: 
- 5 core promptsets onboarded
- weekly runs + alerting to product-evals channel
- documented rollback flow and runbook
If we hit those, mark as beta.

ci-bot: Deploy scheduled runner job created for branch "evals/mvp-schedule" at 1918765400.

raj: Timeline ask — can eng/infra deliver batching rules + docs in 3 sprints? If yes, we can start profiling beta in sprint 4.

matt: Yes if we scope to top 10 patterns and reuse existing metrics plumbing. I'll block time.

derek: I'll draft the playbook doc and sample configs this week. Will ping for reviews.

leila: Decisions summary: 1) Prioritize prescriptive batching + playbook (GA criteria above). 2) Regression monitoring as beta (5 promptsets + weekly alerting). 3) Auto-profiling = opt-in beta for Dedicated/Private in Q2. 4) Quant recs UI deferred to Q3, but we should start validating model heuristics now.

anya: Action items: @matt scope eng tasks, @raj estimate infra work, @derek draft docs, @leila own rollout comms.

matt: I'll post a detailed tech scope by EOD Friday.

raj: I'll put infra estimates into the sprint planning doc by Monday.

leila: Thanks all — will convert this thread into a TL;DR for the roadmap board. :thumbsup:
